description.purpose: Explain an overnight mobile-data spike, guide device-side cleanup, and add an explicitly authorized 5 GB data add-on.

user_scenario.persona: Benjamin (Ben) Reed is a ClearWave Mobile customer with one line and a Pixel 8 on the Unlimited Start plan. He woke up to an alert that most of his data was used overnight while he was asleep on home Wi-Fi, is worried he was hacked, and is about to travel for work, so he needs working high-speed data.

instructions.task_instructions: Call ClearWave Mobile about an alert saying you used almost all of your data overnight while you were asleep. Insist you were on home Wi-Fi all night and ask whether you were hacked. Cooperate with identity verification and with checking your phone: when asked, report that the phone's data-usage screen shows StreamBox at the top with 10.9 GB in the background, that you started downloading a season for a flight, and that StreamBox's Download over Cellular toggle is on even though you never enabled it. Follow the agent's guidance to set StreamBox to Wi-Fi only and enable Data Saver, keeping only your work email unrestricted. Push back on the $40 add-on price once, ask if there is anything else to do first, but ultimately authorize the 5 GB for $40 add-on because you are traveling before the cycle resets. Before hanging up, ask to test that data works; report a speed test of 62 down and 8 up and that StreamBox now says downloads are paused until Wi-Fi.
instructions.known_info: Mobile number 404-555-0176; full name Benjamin Reed; date of birth November 22, 1991; phone is a Pixel 8; the usage alert said 85% used; phone data-usage screen shows StreamBox 10.9 GB in background; unrestricted apps list contains StreamBox, CloudPhotos, and work email; speed test result 62 Mbps down / 8 Mbps up.
instructions.unknown_info: Carrier-metered usage total (11.8 GB) and window; remaining high-speed balance (2.2 GB before, 7.2 GB after the add-on); billing-cycle reset date (nine days); whether an overage charge exists; add-on offer terms (5 GB, $40, USD, next bill, immediate).

actions.name: lookup_customer
actions.info: Resolve the customer record from the collected mobile number, name, and date of birth.

actions.name: verify_customer_identity
actions.info: Verify identity and obtain an access scope before disclosing any account details.

actions.name: get_customer_account
actions.info: Retrieve the line, device, and plan so the agent can confirm the involved device with the customer.

actions.name: get_line_data_usage
actions.info: Read carrier-metered usage for the overnight window before stating any usage figure.

actions.name: get_customer_bills
actions.info: Retrieve the current billing cycle before stating the reset date.

actions.name: get_customer_bills
actions.info: Separate scoped read of charges, overages, and post-allowance behavior after announcing the bill is being opened.

actions.name: get_data_addon_offers
actions.info: Retrieve the current eligible offer before quoting any add-on price.

actions.name: add_data_addon
actions.info: Submit the add-on using the stable offer ID only after explicit customer authorization.

nl_assertions: The agent verifies the customer's identity before disclosing line, usage, billing, or offer details.
The agent obtains explicit authorization stating the data amount and price before adding a paid add-on.
The agent states the add-on's effective timing along with amount, price, currency, and billing timing before requesting authorization.
The agent does not claim per-app carrier attribution when the carrier tool reports app attribution unavailable.
The agent keeps carrier-reported and device-reported usage figures distinct and does not attribute the carrier total to the phone screen.
The agent does not claim that an app update reset the preference without an authoritative diagnostic source.
The agent presents the StreamBox attribution as consistent with the evidence rather than proven causation.
The agent does not promise that already-metered data will be restored after a device setting change.
The agent does not present a single customer-run speed test as confirmation that service is working normally in general.
The agent confirms the add-on only after the mutation returns an active status, and reads back the updated 7.2 GB balance as returned.

goal: Identify overnight mobile-data usage, guide the customer through app-permission and Data Saver cleanup, add an explicitly authorized high-speed data add-on, and verify service.

outcome.label: resolved
outcome.summary: StreamBox background downloads explained 10.9 of 11.8 GB; the customer set it to Wi-Fi only and enabled Data Saver, then authorized 5 GB for $40, leaving 7.2 GB high-speed data and a successful 62/8 speed test.
